Does Brad Pitt die in Wolfs?

He plays The other fixer.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

No. Cuts to black as the diner shootout starts.

Two rival lone-wolf fixers (Pitt and George Clooney) are hired to clean up the same hotel-room 'corpse', which turns out to be a very alive kid full of drugs. After a night dodging Albanian mobsters and returning the stolen product, both are ordered to kill the Kid but choose not to. In the final scene hitmen surround them at a Brighton Beach diner; they agree to finally tell each other their names if they survive, start shooting, and the film cuts to black.

Open-ended, but no death shown. Apple TV+ release; a planned sequel was cancelled.
